selection_basis: v3 primary-literature panel was treated as development data after model iteration. These frozen recipes must be evaluated on a newly curated v4 panel only once.
v4_panel_exclusion_policy: Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-seed.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-expanded-panel.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-postfreeze-holdout.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in every AHTPDB-derived training panel used by the broad-shortlist recipe.
Exclude sequences used during any v3 recipe selection run.
claim_boundary: A paper claim is allowed only if frozen recipes enrich exact-sequence-excluded v4 positives. Do not claim novel discovery, clinical efficacy, or mechanistic proof from this dry-lab validation alone.
